title: Height localization in rotated coordinates: ‖x‖ <= ‖a(x)‖ + dist(x, q(R^n × {0}))
statement: For all n, l ∈ N, every linear isometry q of R^{n+l} and every x ∈ R^{n+l}: ‖x‖ <= ‖a(x)‖ + dist(x, T). Here a(x) := (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q^{-1} x)).1 ∈ R^n is the first block of q^{-1} x, with the Euclidean norm of R^n, and T = rotatedPlane q = q(R^n × {0}). The distance is Metric.infDist to the subspace T.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (x : Amb n ℓ), ‖x‖ ≤ ‖(EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm x)).1‖ + infDist x (rotatedPlane q : Set (Amb n ℓ))
